title: Critical Assessment of Condensate Boundaries in Dual-Color Single Particle Tracking.
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用合成数据基准测试凝聚体边界检测方法（含机器学习），服务于单颗粒-凝聚体互作测量，虽涉及相分离对象与互作测量，但方法侧重图像边界而非PPI机制建模，故给6分。
abstract: Biomolecular condensates are membraneless cellular compartments generated by phase separation that regulate a broad variety of cellular functions by enriching some biomolecules while excluding others. Live-cell single particle tracking of individual fluorophore-labeled condensate components has provided insights into a condensate's mesoscopic organization and biological functions, such as revealing the recruitment, translation, and decay of RNAs within ribonucleoprotein (RNP) granules. Specifically, during dual-color tracking, one imaging channel provides a time series of individual biomolecule locations, while the other channel monitors the location of the condensate relative to these molecules. Therefore, an accurate assessment of a condensate's boundary is critical for combined live-cell single particle-condensate tracking. Despite its importance, a quantitative benchmarking and objective comparison of the various available boundary detection methods is missing due to the lack of an absolute ground truth for condensate images. Here, we use synthetic data of defined ground truth to generate noise-overlaid images of condensates with realistic phase separation parameters to benchmark the most commonly used methods for condensate boundary detection, including an emerging machine-learning method. We find that it is critical to carefully choose an optimal boundary detection method for a given dataset to obtain accurate measurements of single particle-condensate interactions. The criteria proposed in this study to guide the selection of an optimal boundary detection method can be broadly applied to imaging-based studies of condensates.
abstract_zh: 生物分子凝聚体（biomolecular condensates）是由相分离（phase separation）产生的无膜细胞区室，通过富集某些生物分子同时排除其他分子来调节多种细胞功能。对单个荧光标记的凝聚体组分进行活细胞单粒子追踪，为凝聚体的介观组织和生物学功能提供了见解，例如揭示了核糖核蛋白（RNP）颗粒内RNA的招募、翻译和降解过程。具体而言，在双色追踪中，一个成像通道提供单个生物分子位置的时间序列，而另一个通道监测凝聚体相对于这些分子的位置。因此，准确评估凝聚体的边界对于结合活细胞单粒子-凝聚体追踪至关重要。尽管其重要性，由于缺乏凝聚体图像的绝对真实基准，对各种现有边界检测方法的定量基准测试和客观比较尚属空白。在此，我们使用具有明确真实基准的合成数据，生成具有现实相分离参数的噪声叠加凝聚体图像，以基准测试最常用的凝聚体边界检测方法，包括一种新兴的机器学习方法。我们发现，针对给定数据集仔细选择最优边界检测方法对于获得单粒子-凝聚体相互作用的准确测量至关重要。本研究提出的指导选择最优边界检测方法的标准可广泛适用于基于成像的凝聚体研究。
